scope: One-seed reference validation of the standalone NVFlare KD component using a separate FedDF composition.
aggregation: uniform parameter averaging; BN buffers retained from last selected client, as in reference ModuleState.copy_to_module

server.scheduler: cosine to zero over 10000 steps, recreated every round
server.selection: best server-validation checkpoint; original default excludes initial average from best tracker

limitations: Table 1 tunes the local learning rate but does not publish the selected value for this cell; start at README lr=0.1, no search performed.
One chosen seed (7) initially; original table mean/std uses three unspecified seeds.
Modern PyTorch, persistent worker pools and sequential client simulation replace old MPI worker scheduling.
Released proxy loader uses conf.batch_size=64 although the paper describes 128 distillation batches; follow released loader.
The default example workflow uses a different model, data split and aggregation objective.
Neither method reached 75% during the displayed 100-round window; this is not a reproduction of the published Table 1 target-round counts.
